_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/governance-ui/main/src/pages/submit/council-decision-veto.tsx — the live DAO governance dapp Submit-Council-Decision-Veto page. Copy is verbatim from src/intl/en.json (page.submit_council_decision_veto.*, page.submit.* and error.council_decision_veto.*). The proposal payload shape + validation come from src/types/proposals.ts (NewProposalCouncilDecisionVeto { decision_snapshot_id, reasons, suggestions?, coAuthors? }; newProposalCouncilDecisionVetoScheme: reasons minLength 20 maxLength 3500, suggestions minLength 20 maxLength 3500, required ['decision_snapshot_id','reasons','suggestions']). The submission VP gate is SUBMISSION_THRESHOLD_COUNCIL_DECISION_VETO (config; example .env values for other proposal types default to 100, so a sample 2500 floor is used here for the VP-not-met copy demo — the gate copy/behaviour is what matters, not the number). getSnapshotIdFromUrl() in the page extracts the snapshot proposal id from the decision URL hash. Decentraland governance is NOT a Catalyst service (the DAO runs on Snapshot + Aragon externally — confirmed by a catalyrst crate scan: no governance route), and decentraland/governance repo paths 404, so the createProposalCouncilDecisionVeto call is SIMULATED here. No remote calls are made; the copy/validation/flow are faithful, the final submit is a clearly-noted stub.
